action: chunked the crate grid to eight cards per response
why: even at a 2000-token envelope, a reasoning model's hidden reasoning plus a long transcription overflowed — finish_reason 'length', validator caught the truncation
critique: work decomposition is the orchestrator's lever: the acceptance standard (every crate rendered) never moved; only the assignment size did

action: resolved a pipeline collision: the deliver gate's generator command overwrote the model-authored page with the generator's version
why: two pipeline steps claimed the same output path — site/index.html — and the later one won silently
critique: ownership of output paths is now explicit: site/ belongs to the foreman run, the generator renders to a scratch reference. a silent clobber became a named, decided boundary

action: wrote the site-foreman orchestration crate itself
why: Playbook's tool plane is fixture-backed; dispatching open-ended authoring to live models needed a harness that does not exist yet
critique: the single largest intervention of the whole exercise: the platform governed the work but could not yet BE the agent loop

action: runs 1–2 rejected every section; two harness defects found and fixed
why: run 1: markdown fences + literal heading match. run 2: max_tokens=200 starved the reasoning models — finish_reason was 'length' and the visible HTML was decapitated before the heading appeared
critique: the gates refused truncated work and the foreman never faked a pass — but the operator had to own the diagnosis both times. raising the envelope to 2000 tokens lowered no standard: the full fragment is now demanded and validated
